identification: Ferguson, Bibliography of Australia, 7 vols (I 1784-1830 to VII 1851-1900 Q-Z), National Library of Australia imprint on the spines. This is almost certainly the 1975-77 / 1986 NLA facsimile reprint of the Angus & Robertson original (1941-69), not the scarce original. Addenda volume absent. Common reference set, modest value.
